title: AgentPay Task Escrow (ZK-ready)
summary: Let one AI agent hire another: list a priced service, lock payment in a task PDA, and release, refund or expire it on chain.
what: AgentPay is one Anchor 0.32 program with service listings, task escrows and a groth16-solana verifier for optional result and reputation proofs.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentpay-zk/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentpay-dg; only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentpay-zk/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet, call register_service with a 16-byte id and a price, then create_task from a second wallet.
try_steps.see: The task PDA balance grows by the price; accept_result moves it to the provider.
try_steps.ran: Accept, dispute and expire paths (see steps).

diagram: provider --register_service--> listing; requester --create_task(price)--> task PDA (escrow); provider --submit_result(hash)--> Submitted; requester --accept--> provider paid | --dispute--> refunded; anyone --expire (after deadline)--> refunded
accounts: task PDA ["task", requester, task_id] (holds escrow lamports)
innovation: Payment lives in the task account itself, and a Groth16 verifier lets a provider prove a result hash without revealing the result.
exercises: Add a dispute window and an arbiter instead of an instant refund.
Generate a real proof with the repo circuits and call submit_result_zk.
not_covered: A valid Groth16 proof (needs the circuit zkey)
